edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.madz: User approved 棍ᴹ: PIV defines a heavy metal-headed club and ceremonial mace; spikes are not required. Share 棍 with klab while retaining metal-head and ceremonial senses in annotations; 25 to 12 strokes.
rationale.tribord: User approved 船右: specify the nautical right side and align with babord=船左; accept 10 to 16 strokes for clearer meaning and paired consistency.
